newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sumitomo Sitix to spin off titanium operations.
newsitem.headline: Sumitomo Sitix to spin off titanium operations.

text.p: Sumitomo Sitix Corp said on Wednesday that it would spin off its titanium and polysilicon operations into a separate company on October 1, as part of its efforts to improve efficiency.
The new company, which will still be wholly owned by Sumitomo Sitix, will obtain 16.5 billion yen worth of assets from the parent company.

As a result of the move, Sumitomo Sitix calculated that, based on its estimated results for fiscal 1996/97, the spin-off would trim its annual sales by 16.4 billion yen and its current parent profit by 1.5 billion yen.
